{{a|Neuroforce}} (Ultra Necrozma) |location=[[Mount Lanakila]] |current=[[party|With]] the {{player}} |prevonum=800 |noevo=incap |media=game }} '''{{p|Necrozma}}''' (Japanese: '''ネクロズマ''' ''Necrozma''), also referred to as the '''Blinding One''' (Japanese: '''かがやきさま''' ''Radiant One'') by the [[Ultra Recon Squad]], and known as the '''pillager of light''' (Japanese: '''{{ruby|光|ひかり}}の{{ruby|略奪者|りゃくだつしゃ}}''' ''pillager of light'') in [[Alola]] mythology, is a major antagonist in {{g|Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon}}. it serves as one of the main threats in the game, looking to take the light of the Alola [[region]] in order to regain its original [[form]] and power. ==In the core series games== ===History=== ====Background==== Long prior to [[Pokémon Sun and Moon|Pokémon Sun, Moon]], [[Pokémon Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon|Ultra Sun, and Ultra Moon]], Ultra Necrozma traveled through [[Ultra Space]], shining its light across many [[dimension]]s and going through [[Ultra Wormhole]]s, leading to the [[Alola]] [[region]]. This granted it the title of "Blinding One". At some point, the people of [[Ultra Megalopolis]] attempted to gain control of Necrozma in order to recreate the light it possessed, however, this injured Necrozma, causing it to become aggressive, turning its body black, putting the Pokémon in constant pain, and seeking out the light that it once had. According to [[Professor Kukui]], pieces of its body were chipped off and scattered across other [[dimension|world]]s, including Alola. This created the [[Z-Crystal]]s and [[Sparkling Stone]]s that are used to form [[Z-Ring]]s{{Sup/7|SM}}/[[Z-Power Ring]]s{{Sup/7|USUM}} and, by extension, creating [[Z-Move]]s. Necrozma's light came to be known as [[Z-Power]], the energy used for Z-Moves and the aura that surrounds both [[Ultra Beast]]s and [[Totem Pokémon]]. Necrozma had attempted to recover its light from Ultra Megalopolis and return to its original state, resulting in that world being shrouded in darkness. Necrozma traveled to Alola to devour its light, putting the region into darkness. Necrozma was met by the [[guardian deities]] and the [[Legendary Pokémon]], {{p|Solgaleo}}{{sup/7|US}}/{{p|Lunala}}{{sup/7|UM}}, battling them at what would become [[Tapu Village]]. Necrozma had succeeded in this fight against the Legendary Pokémon, devouring Solgaleo/Lunala's light and taking over its body, [[Pokémon fusion|transforming]] into Dusk Mane{{sup/7|US}}/Dawn Wings{{sup/7|UM}} Necrozma as a result. Now dubbed the "pillager of light" by the king of Alola, the tapu and a youth had fought against Necrozma, using the Z-Power from Z-Crystals and Sparkling Stones, which resulted in Necrozma's defeat and banishment from Alola. This story had created the tradition of the young going on their [[island challenge]] at 11 years old. At some point, all information about Necrozma was erased from history and most, but not all, historical books written about the Pokémon were burned to hide its existence. At some point later, Necrozma was locked up in [[Megalo Tower]] by the people of Ultra Megalopolis for its violence, preventing it from dooming anymore worlds. ===={{g|Sun and Moon}}==== Whether the Necrozma encountered here is the same Necrozma found in Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon or a different one altogether is unclear. After the [[player]] has caught all the [[Ultra Beast]]s found in Alola, they will tell [[Anabel]] and [[Wicke]] at [[Aether Paradise]] about their work. [[Looker]] of the [[International Police]] comes into the room, notifying the group of an Ultra Beast that is colored black but was somehow refracting light like a prism. However, the International Police has stated that all the Ultra Beasts they have identified have been [[Caught Pokémon|caught]]. The player goes to [[Ten Carat Hill]] to encounter the mysterious Pokémon, the same way they did with the Ultra Beasts. This Pokémon turns out to be the [[Legendary Pokémon|Legendary]] Necrozma. If the player catches Necrozma, they can talk to Looker on {{rt|2|alola}}'s motel and he will look at Necrozma's [[Pokédex]] data. Looker notices that it matches perfectly with what he had seen before, but concludes it must just be a rare Pokémon. While the encounter method is the same as the Ultra Beasts, Necrozma is unaffected by [[Beast Ball]]s, and its name appears during battle rather than displaying as ???, allowing it to be registered as seen in the Pokédex. ===={{g|Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon}}==== [[File:Ultra Burst artwork.png|thumb|200px|Necrozma undergoing [[Ultra Burst]] atop [[Megalo Tower]]]] Necrozma was being researched by the [[Aether Foundation]] and members of the [[Ultra Recon Squad]] under orders of the Aether Foundation's president, [[Lusamine]]. Lusamine had been told history about Necrozma, and it's escape from [[Megalo Tower]], hoping to prevent its appearance in Alola. In the process, her and the Ultra Recon Squad began research on {{p|Cosmog}}, a Pokémon who can create [[Ultra Wormhole]]s. With Cosmog's power, she can go into [[Ultra Space]] and encounter Necrozma on her own. Lusamine manages to obtain a Cosmog, later known as [[Nebby]]. Knowing that overuse of this power will harm the Cosmog, [[Lillie]] had taken [[Nebby]] away from [[Aether Paradise]], with Lusamine ordering the Ultra Recon Squad to track down the girl and Nebby. Throughout the story, the {{player}} will encounter two members of the Recon Squad who will provide them with information on Cosmog, Necrozma, and any relevant history between them and Alola. Necrozma first appears in person once the player and Lillie make it to [[Poni Island]]'s [[Altar of the Sunne]]{{sup/7|US}}/[[Altar of the Moone]]{{sup/7|UM}}. After Lusamine uses Nebby's power at Aether Paradise and leaves into [[Ultra Space]] with [[Guzma]], the two summon the [[Legendary Pokémon]] with one of Alola's rituals: by [[evolution|evolving]] Nebby into {{p|Solgaleo}}{{sup/7|US}}/{{p|Lunala}}{{sup/7|UM}}. Lillie and the player are amazed by this, only to be interrupted by an Ultra Wormhole appearing behind them. [[Guzma]] is dumped from the wormhole, followed by Lillie's mother. Lusamine warns Lillie to stay away from the monster, with Necrozma reaching through the Ultra Wormhole and making its way into Alola. Nebby takes action and fights against Necrozma, resulting in its defeat. Necrozma pins down Nebby and absorbs its light, transforming into [[List of Pokémon with form differences#Necrozma|Dusk Mane]]{{sup/7|US}}/[[List of Pokémon with form differences#Necrozma|Dawn Wings]]{{sup/7|UM}} Necrozma. With light being drawn from Alola, Poni Island is covered in darkness. The player fights against the now transformed Necrozma and wins. As a form of retreat, Necrozma summons more Ultra Wormholes across Alola, unleashing multiple [[Ultra Beast]]s and alerting the region's [[guardian deities|guardians]]. Necrozma returns into Ultra Megalopolis and attempts to revert back into its original state. Horrified at the events that just occurred, the group meets the Ultra Recon Squad, who provide information on where Necrozma had run off to and what should be done. The player is given the squadron's own Lunala{{sup/7|US}}/Solgaleo{{sup/7|UM}} to [[Ultra Warp Ride|traverse through Ultra Space]] and make their way to Ultra Megalopolis. Being informed by two other members of the Ultra Recon Squad, the player is told that Necrozma is at [[Megalo Tower]]. They make their way up through the illuminated building where they see Necrozma going through [[Ultra Burst]], transforming into [[List of Pokémon with form differences#Necrozma|Ultra Necrozma]], and initiate a battle with it. Necrozma is engulfed with [[Z-Power]], illuminated by a yellow aura which raises all of its [[stat]]s. After a difficult fight with it, Necrozma is defeated and light shines down on Alola once again. Nebby is freed from Necrozma's grasp going home with the player and returning to Lillie. Necrozma disappears, only to be discovered again by the player while traveling up [[Mount Lanakila]]. The weakened Necrozma is found in a crater, and seeks light, leaving the player the option to choose to activate a battle with a higher catch rate than it had in Sun and Moon. After the fight, Necrozma leaves a piece of [[Ultranecrozium Z]], which it can use to temporarily return to its Ultra Necrozma form through [[Ultra Burst]]. If caught, [[Colress]] appears and provides the player with the [[N-Solarizer]] and [[N-Lunarizer]], allowing the player to [[Pokémon|fuse]] Necrozma with any Solgaleo or Lunala they may own. In the post-game, Lillie and Nebby can be found on [[Mahalo Trail]], who suggests that Necrozma would not suffer as much if it was closer to Nebby's light, and offers the Pokémon to the player. ===Personality and characteristics=== {{main|Necrozma (Pokémon)}} Necrozma was worshiped by the people in [[Ultra Megalopolis]] and described as the "Blinding One." In the Alola region, Necrozma was seen as a threat by Alola's ancients, and had its history erased. In {{g|Sun and Moon}} Necrozma is mostly an unknown Pokémon who appears similar to that of an [[Ultra Beast]]. In Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon, Necrozma is a Pokémon that is rather violent and aggressive, seeking out the light it once lost as a result of its injuries. This behavior has resulted in it being locked up and seen as greedy, leaving the Pokémon to have impurities build up in its body and crystalize due to a lack of light. The [[Aether Foundation]] wants to prevent any future harm to Alola that Necrozma may cause. Necrozma is less aggressive by the end of the game, but remains in constant pain, only attacking if provoked. [[Lillie]] sees this problem and provides the player with [[Nebby]] to give Necrozma the light and sustenance that it may need, knowing that both Pokémon may cooperate with one another. ===Appearance=== :''See also: [[Necrozma (Pokémon)#Form data|Necrozma → Form data]]'' Necrozma has four forms, its "weakened form", its Dusk Mane Necrozma form, its Dawn Wings Necrozma form and its original Ultra Necrozma form. Necrozma used to be permanently in its Ultra form; however, after an incident with the ancestors of the Ultra Recon Squad, it lost its light and was reduced to its weakened, dark form. It transformed into Dusk Mane{{sup/7|US}}/Dawn Wings{{sup/7|UM}} Necrozma after {{pkmn|fusion|absorbing}} [[Nebby]], shortly after it evolved into a {{p|Solgaleo}}{{sup/7|US}}/{{p|Lunala}}{{sup/7|UM}}. With Nebby absorbed, Necrozma stole the light of Alola and with it, performed an [[Ultra Burst]], regaining its Ultra form. {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; border:3px solid #{{psychic color dark}}; background:#{{psychic color}}; border-radius: 10px" |- ! style="background:#{{steel color light}}; {{roundytl|5px}}" |Dusk Mane Necrozma ! style="background:#{{ghost color light}}" |Dawn Wings Necrozma ! style="background:#{{dragon color light}}; {{roundytr|5px}}" |Ultra Necrozma |- style="background:#{{psychic color light}}" | style="border:2px solid #{{steel color light}}; background:#{{steel color light}}" |[[File:0800Necrozma-Dusk Mane 2.png|x150px]] | style="border:2px solid #{{ghost color light}}; background:#{{ghost color light}}" |[[File:0800Necrozma-Dawn Wings 2.png|x150px]] | style="border:2px solid #{{dragon color light}}; background:#{{dragon color light}}" |[[File:Ultra Necrozma at Megalo Tower.png|x200px]] |- style="background:#{{psychic color light}}" |} ===In battle=== ====Pokémon Sun and Moon==== ;[[Ten Carat Hill]] In Sun and Moon, Necrozma, like all the [[Ultra Beast]]s, will respawn immediately after its defeat and the player can re-encounter the Pokémon by walking into the tall grass a second time. Unlike the Ultra Beasts, there is no music indicating its presence, using the normal [[Ten Carat Hill]] track that plays in the location. Necrozma uses the "[[Pokémon Sun & Pokémon Moon: Super Music Collection|Battle! (Solgaleo/Lunala)]]" theme that also plays against {{p|Solgaleo}} and {{p|Lunala}}. Necrozma's name also appears as normal and not unknown. It is coded to never be {{Shiny}}. {{Pokémon | gen = 7 | ndex = 0800 | pokemon = Necrozma | gender = none | level = 75 | type1 = Psychic | ability = Prism Armor | move1 = Stealth Rock | move1type = Rock | move1cat = Status | move2 = Iron Defense | move2type = Steel | move2cat = Status | move3 = Wring Out | move3type = Normal | move3cat = Special | move4 = Prismatic Laser | move4type = Psychic | move4cat = Special }} ====Pokémon Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon==== In Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon, Necrozma cannot be caught until it is found at [[Mount Lanakila]]. It is [[shiny]] locked in all encounters and its catch rate is higher than it was in Sun and Moon (255 instead of 3). ;[[Altar of the Sunne]]{{sup/7|US}}/[[Altar of the Moone]]{{sup/7|UM}} {{p|Necrozma}} has fused with [[Nebby]] and attacks both the player and [[Lillie]] during the story. Necrozma is flared with a yellow [[Z-Move|aura]] and has all of its stats raised by one stage. {{Pokémon | caption = '''Aura: +1 in all [[stat]]s''' | gen = 7 | ndex = 0800 | pokemon = Necrozma | form = -Ultra | gender = none | level = 60 | type1 = Psychic | type2 = Dragon | ability = Neuroforce | move1 = Photon Geyser | move1type = Psychic | move1cat = Special | move2 = Smart Strike | move2type = Steel | move2cat = Physical | move3 = Power Gem | move3type = Rock | move3cat = Special | move4 = Dragon Pulse | move4type = Dragon | move4cat = Special }} ;[[Mount Lanakila]] Necrozma is now able to be caught. Necrozma cannot use [[Z-Move]]s or perform [[Ultra Burst]] due to not being fused with Solgaleo or Lunala. After its defeat, Necrozma will drop a piece of Ultranecrozium Z, allowing the player to add it to their collection of [[Z-Crystal]]s. [[Colress]] will give the player the [[N-Solarizer]] and [[N-Lunarizer]] after it has been caught. It is coded to never be {{Shiny}}. {{Pokémon | gen = 7 | ndex = 0800 | pokemon = Necrozma | icon = z-power | gender = none | level = 65 | type1 = Psychic | ability = Prism Armor | held = Ultranecrozium Z | move1 = Photon Geyser | move1type = Psychic | move1cat = Special | z-move1 = Light That Burns the Sky | move2 = Iron Defense | move2type = Steel | move2cat = Status | move3 = Power Gem | move3type = Rock | move3cat = Special | move4 = Night Slash | move4type = Dark | move4cat = Physical }} ==In the spin-off games== ===Pokémon Masters EX=== While Necrozma doesn't appear in person in [[Pokémon Masters EX]], [[Lusamine (Masters)|Lusamine]] references the Pokémon from the one found in Alola, similar to {{g|Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon}}. After thinking that Necrozma is a harmful Pokémon that could steal the light of the world, she realizes treating them with kindness is a better way to go about protecting them. Lusamine pairs up with a different {{p|Necrozma}} in this game, taking into account of her previous actions with the former Necrozma. ==In animation== ===Pokémon Evolutions=== [[File:Necrozma Evolutions.png|thumb|250px|Necrozma in ''[[Pokémon Evolutions]]'']] As a part of ''[[PE02|The Eclipse]],'' Necrozma is found coming through an [[Ultra Wormhole]] after dumping a defeated [[Guzma]] and [[Lusamine]] on the floor of the [[Altar of the Moone]]. Lusamine warns [[Lillie]] to get away from the monster who had defeated her. In a rush, the fully evolved [[Nebby]], now a {{P|Lunala}} initiates a fight with Necrozma to protect the group. However, Necrozma wins the brawl and pins Nebby down, resulting in Necrozma's transformation into [[List of Pokémon with form differences#Necrozma|Dawn Wings Necrozma]] by absorbing Nebby's light.
